parent="source" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="270" y="110" width="150" height="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="semantics" value="<b>Check semantics (every 5 minutes)</b><br><br>1. Every monitored journey is evaluated in each check.<br>2. A cancellation takes priority: no departure or delay<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;notification is sent in the same check.<br>3. Departing the boarding station ends monitoring after<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;the departure region is evaluated, so boarding at<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;the origin still gets its departure notification.<br>4. A transition whose notification is not delivered is<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;not committed; it is re-evaluated at the next check.<br>5. Train not found: log a system error; the journey<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;keeps its current state.<br>6. While the data source is unavailable, journeys are<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;not evaluated.<br>7. Notifications due from both regions for one journey<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;in the same check are combined into one message,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;e.g. "Not yet departed; 10 minutes late"." text.tspan: [band ≥ 1 and band ≠ k] / k := band, notify delay
band = ⌊delay ÷ N⌋; exactly N minutes late is band 1
One notification however many bands are crossed
Flapping across a boundary notifies on each crossing
1. Every monitored journey is evaluated in each check.
2. A cancellation takes priority: no departure or delay
notification is sent in the same check.
3. Departing the boarding station ends monitoring after
the departure region is evaluated, so boarding at
the origin still gets its departure notification.
4. A transition whose notification is not delivered is
not committed; it is re-evaluated at the next check.
5. Train not found: log a system error; the journey
6. While the data source is unavailable, journeys are
7. Notifications due from both regions for one journey
in the same check are combined into one message,
